title: A helper that returns nothing
prompt: Write `log_it`, which prints its parameter and returns nothing. In `solve`, call log_it(n), then return n. The helper prints; solve returns.
hints: A function with no return line simply finishes; printing is not returning.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
